name: Not that Groove
description: While recent advancements in AI music generation have predominantly focused on direct audio synthesis, these systems suffer from inherent rigidity, limiting their utility for professional music producers who require granular, highly malleable creative control. Symbolic music (e.g., MIDI) resolves this constraint by providing editable note-level parameters, yet the natural progression to instruction-driven symbolic music editing remains critically under-explored due to a severe scarcity of paired instruction-MIDI datasets.
